title: An Audience With the Prince
wikitext: {{Questbox | name=An Audience With the Prince | start=[[Grand Magister Rommath]] | faction=Alliance | id= | level=9 | category=Thalassian Highlands | experience = 90 | rewards = | previous = [[Rommath, the Traitor]] | next = [[Rommath, the Saviour]] }} == Objectives == Listen to the conversation between Grand Magister Rommath and Kael'thas. == Description == I will now open a portal to Outland. Brace yourself. You might feel a slight pull, try not to fall down. ==Rewards== * 90 [[XP]] == Progress == My Prince... == Completion == So you see now. Every day, I hear our people label him a traitor, a coward. Yet, I am bound to fulfill his wishes. I do not comprehend his intentions, but I hold steadfast in my belief in him. I only wish more of our people could perceive it in the same light. ==Notes== :'''Grand Magister Rommath says:''' Aseph-ah-balla nah! :''[[Image of Kael'thas]] appears.'' :'''Image of Kael'thas says:''' Rommath, my faithful servant. It has been too long since we last spoke. :'''Grand Magister Rommath says:''' My Prince. I am relieved to see you alive and well. I have much to report... :'''Image of Kael'thas says:''' Yet, I have little time. Are my people well? :'''Grand Magister Rommath says:''' Yes, my Prince. Yet, many wither, as we are unable to sate our addiction. Also, the [[Regency Council]] is torn... :'''Image of Kael'thas says:''' Do not bore me with politics, Rommath. I care little about it. Soon, our people will hunger no more. I will see to it. :'''Grand Magister Rommath says:''' When, my Prince? Many believe that you have forsaken us. They call you a traitor, I can no longer bear the insults... :'''Image of Kael'thas says:''' Soon, Rommath. Maintain silence for now. Until my return, it is better that they forget about me. They cannot afford to be dependent on a mere idea; they require tangible solutions. Do not sow false hope among our people. I will only return when I have discovered the path to our salvation. :'''Grand Magister Rommath says:''' I understand. We await your return. :'''Image of Kael'thas says:''' And I cannot wait to be with me people once more. It won't be long, I promise. :'''Grand Magister Rommath says:''' May you always remember the Light of the Sunwell, my Prince. :''Image of Kael'thas disappears.'' ==Progression== {{The Blood Elves}}
